name: Yami-iro no Douwa
source:
Main characters goes together with his university circle members on a training trip to a pension resort. They finally reach the place but what dark things await them inside.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-august-2002-ever17-out-of.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角与大学社团成员一同前往度假民宿合宿。他们终于抵达目的地，可宅邸里究竟有什么黑暗事物等待着众人？

[译自 [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-august-2002-ever17-out-of.html]vndbreview[/url]]
